BeforeSideTurnEnd.maps_to: on_player_turn_end (paels_tears.py:27-28), dispatched by HookSystem.on_player_turn_end (hooks.py:297-301) from CombatState.end_turn (combat.py:654)
BeforeSideTurnEnd.rationale: PaelsTears.cs:38-46 records `HadLeftoverEnergy = base.Owner.PlayerCombatState.Energy > 0` behind a participation check; paels_tears.py:28 is `self.had_leftover_energy = player.energy > 0`. Slot is right: hooks.py:297-307 documents on_player_turn_end as Hook.BeforeTurnEnd, and BeforeSideTurnEnd is Hook.BeforeTurnEnd's THIRD sub-slot (Hook.cs:1254-1260) -- the last of the three, so anything that spends or grants energy in BeforeSideTurnEndVeryEarly/Early is already counted on both sides. The participation check is structurally satisfied: the sim only fires this from the player's own end_turn. Strictly greater than zero on both sides, so an exactly-empty energy pool records False.

AfterSideTurnStart.maps_to: on_player_turn_started (paels_tears.py:30-33), i.e. the POST-draw turn-start slot
AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: PaelsTears.cs:48-55 grants `PlayerCmd.GainEnergy(base.DynamicVars.Energy.BaseValue, base.Owner)` when the flag is set; CanonicalVars is `new EnergyVar(2)` (line 34) and no AscensionHelper.GetValueIfAscension appears in the file, so ENERGY = 2 (paels_tears.py:21) is the pinned non-ascension value. Slot verified by execution, not off the relics/base.py docstring (PROMPT.md bug class 11): `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order` puts on_player_turn_started after modify_hand_draw and the draw, which is where audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json places AfterPlayerTurnStart / the player-side AfterSideTurnStart (step 23). Note the relic deliberately does NOT clear the flag after granting -- so a second consecutive turn ended with energy left grants again, and a turn ended empty clears it at BeforeSideTurnEnd -- and the sim matches that exactly.

AfterCombatEnd.issue: PaelsTears.cs:57-61 is `HadLeftoverEnergy = false;` and nothing else -- the relic's only reset. The sim clears the flag nowhere. Carries guard G1's LIVE label.

guards.what: G1 (LIVE): `had_leftover_energy` is never reset, so combat 2 opens with +2 free energy on turn 1 (PROMPT.md bug class 13)
guards.issue: MECHANISM: paels_tears.py:25 initialises the flag False in __init__ (once per RUN, at RunState.add_relic) and paels_tears.py:28 sets it True whenever a turn ends with energy unspent; nothing ever clears it. C# clears it at PaelsTears.cs:59. Relic instances live on RunState.relics and are re-attached to every CombatState (relics/base.py:152-154), so the flag survives the combat boundary. FIRST READER traced per bug class 13: paels_tears.py:31's `if self.had_leftover_energy`, inside on_player_turn_started -- which fires on TURN 1 of the next combat, before any on_player_turn_end could refresh the flag, so nothing shadows it. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b11.py tears-reset`): combat 1 turn 1 opens at energy 3 with the flag False; one end_turn with the energy unspent sets it True and turn 2 correctly opens at 5; the SAME instance in combat 2 opens turn 1 at energy 5, where a FRESH instance in the identical combat opens at 3. CONFIRMS the pre-diagnosis in .superpowers/sdd/content-relic-sweeps.md sweep A (`player.energy: 3 -> 5`) rather than re-deriving it; this record adds the reader trace and the flag's own before/after. Both sides ported: Ancient from the ported Pael shrine (events/pael.py OPTION_POOL_1 / Pael.cs:30-36), and ending a turn with energy left over is routine. NOTE the sweep table (content-relic-sweeps.md) assigns paels_tears to batch 13 while the batch-11 brief assigns it here; reported in .superpowers/sdd/relic-batch-11-lessons.md so the two are not audited twice. Same one-line fix as belt_buckle G2 / centennial_puzzle / paels_eye G1 / paels_legion G1: clear the flag in an on_combat_start.

guards.what: G2 (LIVE, mechanism owned by relic/paels_eye G3): on a Pael's Eye extra turn the sim skips on_player_turn_end entirely, so the flag is never refreshed before the extra turn reads it
guards.issue: MECHANISM: the sim's CombatState.end_turn consults should_take_extra_turn FIRST and returns (combat.py:648-652), so on_player_turn_end (combat.py:654) never runs on that turn; C# runs the whole turn-end pass and only then asks (CombatManager.cs:1179 vs :1366). The consequence for THIS relic is that the extra turn's on_player_turn_started reads a stale had_leftover_energy: C# would have just set it from the (necessarily unspent, since no card was played) energy pool and granted +2, whereas the sim grants +2 only if the PREVIOUS turn happened to leave the flag set. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- `py audit/tools/relic_probes_b11.py eye-turnend` shows the on_player_turn_end slot firing without Pael's Eye and not firing with it, on the same end_turn call). Both relics are Ancient and co-obtainable: the ported Pael shrine offers one option from each of three pools per visit (Pael.cs:154-172; events/pael.py) and repeats across acts, with Tears in pool 1 and Eye in pool 3. Per binding rule 3 this is ONE mechanism with ONE verdict: it is recorded in full at audit/records/relic/paels_eye.json guard G3, which owns the extra-turn machinery, and reproduced here because the observable (2 energy) is this relic's.

guards.rationale: Structurally satisfied: the sim fires on_player_turn_end only from the player's own end_turn (combat.py:654) and on_player_turn_started only from PlayerCombatState.start_turn (player.py:184), so the owner is always a participant. Multiplayer-only in effect, noted per the shared contract rather than verdicted as a divergence.

Both ADD to the current pool rather than raising the per-turn maximum, so the +2 is spendable this turn only and does not compound with the next turn's reset. Checked deliberately because the sibling relic paels_flesh in this batch takes the other route (ModifyMaxEnergy) and confusing the two would make Pael's Tears permanent.
